# E0412: a lacunas key names a mapping the lens does not have

A lacunas key names a mapping of the lens. A key that names none is usually a
typo. A derived mapping, such as the backward drop of a field the version
added, is not one: to refine its lacuna, write the drop.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	firstfield: string
}
```

`ship/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	firstfield:  string
	secondfield: int
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		secondfield: -1
	}
	lacunas: {
		secondfeild: [{
			type:    Placeholder
			message: "-1 is a placeholder"
		}]
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0412]: lacunas.secondfeild: ForwardLens has no mapping keyed secondfeild
  --> 1.0.thema:12:17
   |
12 |         secondfeild: [{
   |                       ^
   |
```
